product.olivetti-cp486.summary: The EISA 486 platform provisioned for an optional i860 processor.
product.olivetti-cp486.history: The Olivetti service guide documents CP486 (the EISA 486 platform provisioned for an optional i860 processor).
product.olivetti-cp486.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA847 / BA867 · GO734 / GO739 · SCSI.
product.olivetti-cp486.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.03.
product.olivetti-cp486.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-cp486.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-cp486.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 13-1.
